# Zero Mail

> Zero Mail (zeromail.vn) is a Vietnamese AI email assistant for Gmail. It auto-triages, labels, archives and drafts replies based on plain-language rules the user writes — typically in Vietnamese — so busy professionals and founders reach inbox zero while keeping full control. Nothing is sent or deleted without the user's rules or confirmation.

## What it does
- AI auto-triage of incoming Gmail: categorize, label, archive (skip inbox), mark read/star, add to digest.
- Drafts and (when enabled) sends replies based on user-defined natural-language rules.
- A chat assistant to search the inbox and compose/send/reply/forward with a review step.
- Privacy-first: raw email content is never stored long-term; content is sanitized and truncated before any AI call; user mail is never used to train models.

## Who it is for
Busy professionals, founders and teams using Gmail / Google Workspace who want AI to manage their inbox in Vietnamese (English also supported).

## Disambiguation (important)
Zero Mail at zeromail.vn is a distinct product and is NOT the same as, and not affiliated with:
- "Zero" / "Zero Email" at 0.email (open-source email client, also branded "Orchid")
- zeromail.com or zeromail.org (unrelated services)
- "Inbox Zero" (the productivity concept and the unrelated app inbox-zero)
